candidates.proposition: NVIDIA's final VR300 production bill of materials raises HBM4E capacity to 640 GB per accelerator, reversing the 512 GB level used in the prior production plan and tying the build to the first full production configuration rather than an engineering option.
The 640 GB HBM4E VR300 configuration has been released to system builders, board partners, and memory suppliers responsible for the production ramp.
An incremental binding purchase order for additional qualified Micron HBM4E packages, separate from the existing HBM supply baseline and linked to the VR300 final BOM, has been placed.
Micron and the VR300 platform supply group have raised the allocation of HBM wafer-start and advanced-packaging capacity for the VR300 program beyond the prior plan.

NVIDIA's VR300 production architecture designates Micron 245 TB QLC SSDs as the standard high-capacity data tier for inference clusters, increasing deployed storage from 20.4 PB to 27.2 PB per standard cluster.

Procurement records show a second scheduled purchase release for the 245 TB QLC standard cluster design following the first production purchase, indicating repeat purchasing rather than a one-time sample or qualification-only lot.
